scheme_name: Kotwar Cycle Evam Torch Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered as an unorganized worker in any district of Chhattisgarh.
Applicant must not have received a cycle or torch under any previous assistance scheme of the state government.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹3,000 per person for a bicycle or ₹750 per person for a torch.
